ideas.pitch: An AI-enhanced lost and found portal utilizing Gemini AI for multimodal item matching and geospatial mapping to track campus items.
ideas.title: CampusFind AI: Multimodal Lost and Found Platform
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets a pain familiar to students and campus organisers in the room, leveraging multimodal AI for instant visual matching.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered satellite monitoring tool to track unauthorized construction and green cover changes on sprawling campus grounds.
ideas.title: GeoNex-Campus: Satellite Monitoring for Institutional Land Compliance
ideas.why_it_could_win: Brings hard engineering and complex computer vision/satellite data analysis into a 24-hour hackathon, impressing judges with technical depth.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered video intelligence platform transforming unstructured lecture recordings into searchable, timestamped, accessible notes and transcripts.
ideas.title: LibrAI: Campus Lecture Video Intelligence Platform
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves an immediate academic pain point for university students and professors, making it deeply relatable to local judges.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered nutrition and wellness platform delivering personalized meal recommendations and nutritional insights based on hostel mess menus.
ideas.title: E-Foodiee Campus Mess Nutrition Assistant
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets student health and daily hostel life, ensuring high engagement and practical utility during judging demonstrations.

ideas.pitch: A biomechanical cricket shot analyzer using MediaPipe Pose and machine learning classification to give instant form feedback for college athletes.
ideas.title: CricketVision AI: Campus Sports Biomechanical Analyzer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Showcases complex computer vision implementation with real-time pose estimation, appealing to the technical focus on AI/ML.
